name: chris/aldervast-mcp
description: A small, readable demo of the Claude tool-calling loop, and the same tools as an MCP server.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the offline tests (no network needed).
scripts-descriptions.test:live: Check that the real website still works with the code.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the offline tests with code coverage, and fail if any tool is below 80%.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage-html: Write a code coverage report to .phpunit.cache/html/index.html.
scripts-descriptions.test:mutation: Run mutation testing with Infection, and fail if the score is below 90%.
scripts-descriptions.log: Show the MCP server's recent tool calls, grouped by session (add -- 200 for more).
scripts-descriptions.eval: Run the eval: every question in evals/cases.json through the agent loop. CALLS THE PAID API.
